name: StringKeyParser::CrcTables::Initialize (CRC24/CRC32 table build, __thiscall, returns this)
notes: Hooked (StringKeyParser_CrcTables_Initialize, CRC 0x7ab7edf3), not run in-game. Builds tables at game globals 0x10f51d0 (CRC24, poly 0x1864cfb) and 0x10f55d0 (CRC32, poly 0x4c11db7), flag byte 0x10f59d0 set before the tables are written. Test: 300 cases from ready and not-ready starts (garbage tables), compares this, the tables and the flag. Mutants: CRC32 poly 0x4c11db6 and CRC24 test bit 0x800000: 2 of 2 killed.

name: StringKeyParser::Crc24 (CRC24 of a string, optional tolower, seed 0xb704ce, masked to 24 bits)
notes: Hooked (StringKeyParser_Crc24, CRC 0x9d10f810), not run in-game. Test: 20000 cases of mixed case, digits and high bytes (0x80-0xff), lengths up to 40 and around 15, flag values with high bits set, starts with and without ready tables. Compares the result and the table state. Mutants: signed char read changed to unsigned: survived, equivalent (the index uses only the low byte, and tolower leaves 0x80-0xff unchanged in the C locale); mask 0xfffffe: killed.

name: StringKeyParser::Crc32 (CRC32 of a string, MSB first, seed 0xffffffff, no final xor)
notes: Hooked (StringKeyParser_Crc32, CRC 0xa39a9f5c), not run in-game. Test: 20000 cases as Crc24, full 32-bit result compared. Mutants: seed 0 killed; poly 0x4c11db6 (in the table build) killed.

name: StringKeyParser::ParseNumber (strtoul, base 16 after 0x/0X, else 10)
notes: Hooked (StringKeyParser_ParseNumber, CRC 0x1ebb343b), not run in-game. Test: 20000 cases with prefixes (none, 0, 0x, 0X, odd ones), digits, letters, signs, trailing text and an overflowing value; full eax compared. Mutant: 0x prefix test changed: killed.

name: StringKeyParser::EnsureServiceObject (cache global 0x10f8f2c from GetServiceObject slot 5, then AddRef)
notes: Hooked (StringKeyParser_EnsureServiceObject, CRC 0x835d04bc), not run in-game. Test: 2000 cases with a fake service (slot 5 records its identifiers and stores an object; result al 0, 1, 0x100, 0xff, 0x101) and a fake object (slot 1 records AddRef); compares the calls and the cache global. The original's return value (leftover eax) is not reproduced; no caller reads it. Mutants: cache check inverted, success test inverted, AddRef slot 2 instead of 1: killed 3 of 3 (the first two in the mutants batch with the parser tests).

name: cRZString::LowerCase helper (_strlwr of the string at this+4; cRZString group helper, not a vtable slot)
notes: Hooked (cRZString_LowerCase_Helper, CRC 0xbd7614ec), not run in-game. Test: 20000 mixed-case strings with high bytes; compares the whole object. Mutant: lowercasing removed: killed. Calls _strlwr (the same CRT function the original reaches through 0x844708, identified by Ghidra FID only, not byte-matched).

name: cRZString helper EndsWithObject (asks a cIGZString for slot 7 length and slot 5 text, then EndsWith)
notes: Hooked (cRZString_EndsWithObject_Helper, CRC 0xab1426e6), not run in-game. Byte-identical copy at 0x1acb2c (db/families.jsonl) is not hooked. Test: 20000 cases, suffix and unrelated texts, case flips, flag values with high bits; compares the result and both objects. Mutant: flag forced to 1: killed.

name: cRZString helper EndsWith(text, length, caseSensitive) (cRZString group helper)
notes: Hooked (cRZString_EndsWith_Helper, CRC 0x0e9c5251), not run in-game. Case-sensitive path: last length characters compared (false when length exceeds the size). Other path: lowercased copies of both, then the same comparison. Test: 20000 cases, suffixes with case flips, lengths past the ends, flag values with high bits. Mutants: flag inverted, lowercasing of either copy removed, character index direction: all killed.

name: StringKeyParser::ParseKey (string key parser: name!text, *!text, #num!text, ##num!text, text; keyword table and bsearch)
notes: Hooked (StringKeyParser_ParseKey, CRC 0xa3cb43b1), not run in-game. Returns true (al=1). Test: 20000 cases over all branches: random keys with the prefixes above, long texts (heap path), keyword literals read from the game image (5-byte suffixes, any case), game table texts (so the bsearch hit path runs), presets, ext null/empty/set, and a fake service that hands out nothing, a failing query, or a successful one. Compares al, the four out dwords, the cache global and the calls the fakes saw. Mutants: CRC constant in the no-service star path (killed after adding the null-service case), hit mask (killed after adding table-text keys), keyword cs flag, general path always hashed with the CRC instead of the service: all killed. The bsearch comparator is ours (CompareEntry), so the original 0xae7460 is not called from the replacement. Exceptions (length over 0x7fffffff: std::length_error) are not tested.
